english.note: Use this mainly in written or formal comparisons where the two clauses are presented in parallel.

examples.english: The elder brother chose to work in Hong Kong, whereas the younger brother plans to emigrate.
examples.traditional: 哥哥選擇留港工作，而弟弟則計劃移民外國。
